title: AI-guided spatial genomics maps variant-intolerance regions in the cardiac sarcomere
summary: A preprint first posted October7,2025 combined AlphaFold-family structures, AlphaMissense scores and observed clinical/population variants to map disease-associated regions in six cardiac sarcomeric genes. The reviewed November22,2026 v3 explains that selected high- and low-scoring predicted substitutions enlarged the variant analysis by50%, revealing nine additional candidate regions, including signals absent from observed-data-only analyses. These additions are predicted variant labels, not additional patients; the population databases overlap and the HCM registry subset differs from the full cardiomyopathy registry. ClinVar and clinical-onset checks were retrospective, and prediction-dependent regions require further validation rather than establishing causal mechanisms or prospective clinical prediction.

evidence.tested: Retrospective spatial scans used SHaRe data (over17,000 cardiomyopathy patients, including12,326 HCM and4,427 six-gene variant carriers), overlapping population databases, predicted structures and selected AlphaMissense substitutions. ClinVar annotations and clinical-onset associations supplied retrospective cross-checks.
evidence.unknown: The nine additional signals depend on selected in-silico substitutions and require further validation. gnomAD and UK Biobank overlap, so their cohort sizes are not summed as unique people. Predicted labels do not establish HCM-specific causality/severity, and ClinVar/cohort checks are not prospective clinical validation or independent research replication.
evidence.ai_role: AlphaFold-family structure prediction and AlphaMissense pathogenicity scoring provided model outputs used to expand variant cohorts and locate 3D regions of disease-associated enrichment.

source_review.scope: Primary latest bioRxiv v3 PDF: model/AlphaMissense selection and variant-augmentation Methods; population-overlap/cohort descriptions; selected spatial/clinical Results and candidate-region limitations. Compared with v1 PDF sections and primary API version history; v2 body was not independently read.
